title: Mastermix Filling 9 Plates
author: Opentrons
materials: Aspirate mastermix volume according to mastermix selected.
Dispense into all wells, multi-dispensing if possible.

steps.title: Prepare reservoir source columns
steps.instruction: Fill the two wells of the reservoir with the selected mastermix (one of six possible mastermixes) so that the source columns are evenly loaded; this mastermix will be used to fill all 108 columns across the nine plates.

steps.title: Aspirate mastermix from reservoir
steps.instruction: Using the automatically assigned pipette (respecting its maximum volume), aspirate the required mastermix volume from the reservoir wells in the repeating sequence A1, A2, A1, … as needed for multi‑dispensing.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the A1‑A2 sequence until the total volume needed is collected

steps.title: Dispense mastermix into plates
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated mastermix into every well of the 108 columns across the nine plates, employing multi‑dispensing when possible to maximize the pipette’s maximum volume.
